nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory Weekly Update: SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A & RSV in “High” category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 & RSV levels are declining. Other respiratory viruses (Influenza B, HMPV, & EV-D68) remain in “Low” wastewater category nationwide & not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/K0n0lSRiqJ

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the “High” category with high concentrations and a no significant trend up or down over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/jLnWXRC6lo

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.3 variant in light blue (27.6%) and XEC variant in green (33.2%) make up approximately 61% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/yBBftQINqQ

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the “High” category with high concentrations and an upward trend over the last 3 weeks. Flu B is in the “Low” category nationally and in all regions. https://t.co/Tksha4sEkV

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 detected in 19 states since start of monitoring - AR, CA, CO, DE, FL, IA, ID, IL, KS, ME, MI, MN, NE, NV, NJ, SD, TN, TX, & UT. As of 2/6/24, CA, CO, IA, ID, MI, MN, NV, SD, TX & UT report infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detections in CA & KS. https://t.co/A1UoqnJW10

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and no significant trend up or down over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/TsXEkkYWbO

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ EV-D68: EV-D68 is in the “Low” category nationally and in all regions. Levels are very low in all regions except the West, where they are beginning to decrease. https://t.co/uMVpbpMKGJ

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and an upward trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions remain in the “High” category. https://t.co/Jp9g0HRx6s
